questions.prompt: Choose the correct passive form: The new library ______ next year.
questions.explanation: 图书馆是被建造，用被动语态 will be + 过去分词。
questions.evidence: The chosen project will be funded by the city

questions.prompt: Choose the correct passive form: The letters ______ by the committee yesterday.
questions.explanation: 信是被审查，过去时被动用 were + 过去分词。
questions.evidence: they are being reviewed by a committee

questions.prompt: Choose the best causal word: The park costs more ______ trees and benches are expensive.
questions.explanation: 后面是原因，用 because 引导原因状语从句。
questions.evidence: This plan would cost more than the other two because trees and benches are expensive.

questions.prompt: Choose the best causal word: The budget is limited, ______ the park may not be approved.
questions.explanation: 前面是原因，后面是结果，用 so 连接。
questions.evidence: The city budget is limited, and the park would require ongoing maintenance.

questions.prompt: Identify the participle used as an adjective: In 'the chosen project', which word is the participle?
questions.explanation: chosen 是过去分词，放在名词 project 前作定语。
questions.evidence: The chosen project will be funded by the city

questions.prompt: Identify the participle phrase: In 'the money collected', what does 'collected' modify?
questions.explanation: collected 是过去分词短语，修饰前面的名词 money。
questions.evidence: The money collected would be used to buy tools and seeds.

answers: The playground would be designed for children.
questions.explanation: 游乐场是被设计，用被动 would be + 过去分词。
questions.evidence: It would be designed for children aged three to twelve.

questions.prompt: Choose the best causal word: ______ the garden is small, only twenty families can have plots.
questions.explanation: 前后是因果关系，前面是原因，用 Because。
questions.evidence: the lot is small, so only about twenty families could have plots.

title: A City Weighs Three Public-Space Proposals · 规则与新语境练习
instructions: 先阅读本组中文规则与原句，区分新结构和已学规则，再完成独立句子；同一材料再次出现属于巩固，保持原ID。
passage:
本课重点：1) 被动语态：be + 过去分词，强调动作承受者。例如：The proposals were submitted. 2) 因果表达：because, so, therefore, as a result 等。例如：because trees and benches are expensive. 3) 分词作定语：单个分词放在名词前，如 the chosen project；分词短语放在名词后，如 the money collected。辨认时先找名词，再看分词修饰谁。

The proposals were submitted by local groups, and they are being reviewed by a committee this month.
